verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own docs say any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client (Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail) can connect to an AgentMail inbox, which covers open-protocol access. Nothing in the evidence shows JMAP support or a standards-based export (e.g. mbox/EML bulk export), so only part of the anti-lock-in story is evidenced. Missing for 10: JMAP access, standards-based mailbox export, depth documentation of the IMAP/SMTP feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in

citations.quote: Connect Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client to your AgentMail inbox
